instructor: Asst. Prof. Dr. Ali Fahim Ni'ma
subject: 04_Advanced_Software_Eng

questions.question: The most suitable model for new technology that is not well understood is...
questions.question_ar: النموذج الأنسب لتقنية جديدة غير مفهومة جيداً هو...
options: the RAD model here now at all
options_en: the RAD model here now at all
questions.explanation: When the technology is unclear, the product must evolve as understanding grows.
questions.explanation_ar: عندما تكون التقنية غير واضحة يجب أن يتطور المنتج مع نمو الفهم.

questions.question: How does evolutionary development proceed?
options: build a skeleton then grow it
write all tests first now too
options_en: build a skeleton then grow it
write all tests first now too
questions.explanation: A working skeleton is extended step by step as understanding grows.
questions.explanation_ar: هيكل عامل يُوسَّع خطوة بخطوة مع نمو الفهم.

questions.question: Why is a prototype built early?
options: to measure the final cost too
options_en: to measure the final cost too
questions.explanation: The prototype gives users something concrete to react to, which surfaces the real needs.
questions.explanation_ar: النموذج يعطي المستخدمين شيئاً ملموساً يتفاعلون معه، فتظهر الحاجات الحقيقية.

questions.question: Which prototype is thrown away afterwards?
questions.question_ar: أي نموذج أولي يُهمل بعد ذلك؟
questions.explanation: A throw-away prototype only exists to settle requirements, so it is discarded.
questions.explanation_ar: النموذج المُهمَل يوجد فقط لتثبيت المتطلبات، فيُترك.

questions.question: What is the main risk of evolutionary prototyping?
options: the user never sees it now too now
the cost is fixed too early here too
options_en: the user never sees it now too now
the cost is fixed too early here too
questions.explanation: Because the product grows from a prototype, structure is rarely designed up front.
questions.explanation_ar: لأن المنتج ينمو من نموذج أولي، نادراً ما تُصمَّم البنية مسبقاً.

questions.question: When should evolutionary development be chosen?
options: when the scope is frozen too
when cost is fixed here now
options_en: when the scope is frozen too
when cost is fixed here now
questions.explanation: Unclear requirements and new technology need a model that learns as it builds.
questions.explanation_ar: المتطلبات غير الواضحة والتقنية الجديدة تحتاج نموذجاً يتعلم وهو يبني.

questions.question: What does prototyping mainly improve?
questions.explanation: A visible prototype replaces abstract discussion with something both sides can judge.
questions.explanation_ar: النموذج المرئي يستبدل النقاش المجرد بشيء يحكم عليه الطرفان.

questions.question: What is the classic drawback of prototyping?
options: the cost is always lower here
options_en: the cost is always lower here
questions.explanation: A prototype can keep being polished forever, because it has no defined stopping rule.
questions.explanation_ar: النموذج قد يُصقل بلا نهاية لأنه بلا قاعدة توقف محددة.
